name: Dwarven Scavenger
notes: Spoil logic (all bands): Spoil first, packs with Spoil Bomb / Spoil Festival, then AoE, then Sweeper on every spoiled corpse before picking up drops.
Open question: corpse time for sweeping on L2Toggle.

rows.trig: Attack: auto-attack (dagger or blunt). No damage skills in this band.

when.text: the mobs are in front of me

rows.trig: Polearm, FAN: >= 2 mobs in front. Packs of 3+: Festival, then Wild Sweep, then sweep each corpse.

Spoil Festival (28+): packs of 3+: Festival, then Wild Sweep, then sweep each corpse. Spoil logic 2: packs (>= 3 mobs): Spoil Festival (28+: up to 10 in r200 around the target; 204 MP), then AoE them down, then sweep ("Spoil Festival, then mass attack with a pike, then sweep", l2-servera).

Spoil: Spoil logic 1: spoil the target before it dies, ideally as the first action (magic land chance, 40 range). If it says "spoil failed", retry once or twice while the mob has > 30 % HP. Skip low-value mobs. In a party the spoiler spoils while the others hold their attacks for about 1 s, or the spoiler opens the pull.

Sweeper: sweep each corpse. Spoil logic 3: sweep every spoiled corpse right after the kill, before picking up drops (drops stay on the ground longer than corpses). Make sweep priority 1 the moment a spoiled mob dies; corpses last about 7 s on L2J, longer for spoiled ones [?]. 0.5 s reuse, 20 range, needs a corpse.
Sweep 2+ spoiled corpses at once (Sweeper Festival 444; checked in game 2026-10-26: Spoiler16 has it learned on L2Toggle). One corpse: Sweeper 42.
rows.why: verified in game 2026-10-26 (the guide doubted it; L2Toggle has it)

rows.trig: Self-heal: Bandage (was excluded from the extract) out of combat only.
